The compilation errors indicate a problem with macro definitions in `subsys/testsuite/ztest/include/zephyr/ztest_test.h`. Specifically, several multi-line macros for defining parameterized test value sets are missing line-continuation backslashes (`\`). This causes the preprocessor to interpret only the first line as part of the macro, leading to syntax errors when the compiler processes the subsequent lines.

The fix is to add the missing backslashes to ensure the entire intended body of each macro is correctly processed.
